The climate in Oslo

Oslo is about 21 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 21°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −6°C. Around 940 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in July (about 112 mm).

Best time to visit Oslo

The most pleasant weather in Oslo is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 20°C and 21°C, with up to 13 days of rain a month. In January, February and December nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
